marta: proposed short triage excerpt to merge:
1) Confirm symptom: eviction spike or OOMs on router pool.
2) Quick checks:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=router -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=router --since=15m | grep -i "Evicted\|OOM" || true
redwood infra autoscaler status --pool router --since 15m > /tmp/auto.out
```
3) If evictions > 3 in 15m -> escalate to infra-oncall and attach /tmp/auto.out.
4) If no ack in 10m -> page eng-pager with template.
